summary.zh: 在 NotebookLM 查资料并生成音视频概览
summary.en: Query NotebookLM notes and generate overviews, reports and slides.

description.zh: 在 Google NotebookLM 中检索笔记、添加资料，生成音频或视频概览、报告、记忆卡和幻灯片。适合把一堆文档快速整理成可听可看的材料。需要浏览器自动化环境并已登录 NotebookLM。
description.en: Queries notebooks, adds sources and generates Audio or Video Overviews, reports, flashcards and slides in Google NotebookLM. Good for turning a folder of documents into reviewable material. Needs browser automation and a signed-in session.
